name: openbb_fixedincome_moody
description:
Meant to give Moody's Aaa and Baa corporate bond yields through OpenBB (obb.fixedincome.corporate.moody).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (schema default fred; when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.fixedincome.corporate.moody, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: fred_credit_spread or fred_high_yield_spread.
Example: {"provider": "fred"}
